headline: Recommended approval of a Main Street loading zone and two-hour metered parking, a stop sign at West Boylston Dr. and Scrimgeour Rd., and No Parking signs on Hamilton St.
summary: The committee recommended approval of an ordinance for a commercial loading zone and two-hour metered parking on part of Main Street. It also recommended approval of a stop sign at West Boylston Dr. and Scrimgeour Rd. and No Parking signage on Hamilton St. Other petitions were recommended for filing or holding, including requests for Indian Hill Rd., 425 Lake Ave. North, 15 Windham St., and a bus stop between Chino Ave. and 12 Boylston St.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the July 22, 2026 meeting by a 3-0 roll call vote.
Recommended holding the request to remove the bus stop between Chino Ave. and 12 Boylston St., 3-0.
Recommended approval of 20-foot No Parking Here to Corner signage along Hamilton St. at its intersections with Commonwealth Ave., Middlesex Ave., and Boston Ave., 3-0.
Recommended approval of an ordinance establishing a commercial loading zone and two-hour metered parking on a portion of Main Street, 3-0.
Recommended approval of a stop sign facing Scrimgeour Rd. at West Boylston Dr., 2-0 with Ojeda absent.
Recommended filing the request for a right turn only lane on Lincoln St. at its intersection with Plantation St., 2-0 with Ojeda absent.
Recommended filing the request for a stop sign on Indian Hill Rd. at Marconi Rd., 3-0.
Recommended approval of the yield sign request on Indian Hill Rd. at Marconi Rd., 3-0.
Recommended filing the request for Do Not Block Intersection signage and markings at Indian Hill Rd. and Marconi Rd., 3-0.
Recommended filing the request for Blind Driveway signage in front of 425 Lake Ave. North, 3-0.
Recommended filing the request for Do Not Block Driveway signage in front of 15 Windham St., 3-0.
